airspace.zh: 埃及法律規定，未經國防部核准不得使用無人機；遊客不要攜帶或操作無人機，實際飛行前必須先取得官方許可。
airspace.en: Egyptian law prohibits drone use without the approval of the Ministry of Defence; visitors should not bring or fly drones without official permission obtained in advance.

plateau.note: UNESCO reference point of Memphis and its Necropolis

title.en: A Century of the Fourth Dynasty

tagline.zh-Hant: 古夫、卡夫拉、孟卡拉三位法老，與蓋了三千八百年最高紀錄的金字塔
tagline.en: Khufu, Khafre, Menkaure, and a building that stayed the tallest for 3,800 years

zh: 這裡是埃及吉薩，
開羅市中心西南方約十三公里。
en: This is Giza in Egypt,
about 13 kilometres south-west of central Cairo.

zh: 三座大金字塔與人面獅身像，
都建於古埃及第四王朝。
en: The three great pyramids and the Sphinx
all date from the Fourth Dynasty.

zh: 大約是公元前二六〇〇到二五〇〇年，
古王國時期。
en: That is roughly 2600 to 2500 BC,
in the Old Kingdom.

zh: 最大的是古夫金字塔，
約建於公元前二五八〇到二五六〇年。
en: The largest is the Great Pyramid of Khufu,
built around 2580 to 2560 BC.

zh: 它原本高一百四十六點六公尺，
是三千八百多年間世界上最高的人造建築。
en: It once stood 146.6 metres tall,
the tallest human-made structure for more than 3,800 years.

zh: 卡夫拉的金字塔在它西南方幾百公尺，
高度略矮一些。
en: Khafre's pyramid stands a few hundred metres to the south-west,
slightly smaller.

zh: 再往西南是孟卡拉金字塔，
約在公元前二五一〇年完成。
en: Farther south-west is Menkaure's pyramid,
completed around 2510 BC.

zh: 東側的人面獅身像，
一般認為是卡夫拉在位時刻成的。
en: On the east side, the Sphinx is thought to date
from Khafre's reign.

zh: 誰蓋了金字塔？
希羅多德在公元前四五〇年聽說是四十萬人、二十年。
en: Who built them? Herodotus, visiting in 450 BC,
was told 400,000 men had worked for 20 years.

zh: 墓葬證據則顯示，
大約一萬名工人輪班三個月，一座要約三十年。
en: Tomb evidence points instead to about 10,000 labourers
in three-month shifts, about 30 years per pyramid.

zh: 考古學家馬克・萊納的團隊，
在卡夫拉與孟卡拉金字塔東南方找到工人村。
en: Mark Lehner's team found the workers' village
south-east of the Khafre and Menkaure complexes.

zh: 吉薩是整片金字塔區最北的一段；
往南還有薩卡拉與達舒爾。
en: Giza is the northernmost part of the pyramid fields;
Saqqara and Dahshur lie to the south.

zh: 1979年，從吉薩到達舒爾的金字塔區，
連同孟菲斯列入世界遺產。
en: In 1979 the pyramid fields from Giza to Dahshur,
with Memphis, became World Heritage.

zh: 四千五百年前的一個王朝，
在沙漠邊緣留下了這片地景。
en: A dynasty of four and a half thousand years ago
left this landscape on the edge of the desert.

title.en: Boats and Queens for the Afterlife

tagline.zh-Hant: 王后金字塔、太陽船與人面獅身像的鼻子
tagline.en: Queens' pyramids, Khufu's boat and the Sphinx's missing nose

zh: 金字塔是法老的陵墓，
周圍還有一整套為來世準備的設施。
en: The pyramids are royal tombs,
surrounded by a whole set of buildings for the afterlife.

zh: 古夫金字塔旁有三座王后金字塔，
編號G1-a、G1-b、G1-c。
en: Beside Khufu's pyramid are three queens' pyramids,
numbered G1-a, G1-b and G1-c.

zh: 還有三個船坑；
南側兩個坑裡，發現時船還完整。
en: There are also three boat pits;
the two on the south side held intact ships when excavated.

zh: 修復後的古夫之船，
如今在大埃及博物館展出。
en: The restored Khufu ship
is now in the Grand Egyptian Museum.

zh: 卡夫拉的金字塔有五個船坑，
還有一座附屬金字塔。
en: Khafre's pyramid has five boat pits
and a subsidiary pyramid.

zh: 孟卡拉金字塔旁，
也有三座王后金字塔。
en: Menkaure's pyramid, too,
has three queens' pyramids beside it.

zh: 人面獅身像長七十三公尺、高二十公尺，
從岩盤直接刻出來。
en: The Sphinx is 73 metres long and 20 metres high,
carved out of the bedrock.

zh: 它面朝正東，
臉孔一般認為是卡夫拉。
en: It faces due east;
its face appears to represent Khafre.

zh: 鼻子是被人用棍棒或鑿子刻意去掉的，
不是拿破崙軍隊的砲彈打掉的。
en: Its nose was deliberately removed with rods or chisels,
not shot off by Napoleon's troops.

zh: 拿破崙之前的畫作就已經沒有鼻子，
十五世紀的史學家馬克里齊也提過。
en: Artwork from before Napoleon already shows it missing,
and the 15th-century historian al-Maqrizi mentioned it.

zh: 三座金字塔的四邊，
都精準對齊東西南北。
en: The sides of all three pyramids
are aligned to the cardinal directions with great precision.

zh: 古夫金字塔各邊的平均偏差，
只有約三分三十八秒角，約十分之一度。
en: The Great Pyramid's sides deviate on average
by only 3 minutes 38 seconds of arc, about a tenth of a degree.

zh: 往東北十多公里，
就是開羅市中心。
en: A little over ten kilometres to the north-east
is central Cairo.

zh: 城市與陵墓，
如今只隔著幾公里。
en: The modern city and the tombs
are now only a few kilometres apart.

title.en: A Plateau on the Edge of the Desert

tagline.zh-Hant: 尼羅河、石灰岩高原與從南方延伸過來的金字塔群
tagline.en: The Nile, a limestone plateau, and pyramid fields stretching south

zh: 金字塔蓋在吉薩高原上，
離尼羅河約九公里。
en: The pyramids stand on the Giza plateau,
about nine kilometres west of the Nile.

zh: 往西是沙漠，往東是河谷與城市。
en: West lies the desert; east, the river valley and the city.

zh: 高原的岩層是石灰岩，
大部分石塊就地取自穆卡塔姆層。
en: The plateau is limestone;
most of the pyramid stone came from the underlying Mokattam Formation.

zh: 古夫金字塔外層原本包著
圖拉出產的細白石灰岩。
en: The Great Pyramid was once cased
in fine white limestone from Tura.

zh: 中世紀時外殼大多被拆走，
底部還留著一些。
en: Most of the casing was stripped in the Middle Ages;
some casing stones remain at the base.

zh: 卡夫拉金字塔的頂端，
還保留著原本的外殼石。
en: Khafre's pyramid still keeps
some of its casing stones at the apex.

zh: 孟卡拉金字塔則已完全看不到原本的外殼。
en: Menkaure's pyramid is the only one seen today without its original casing.

zh: 沿著沙漠邊緣往南，
金字塔一路延伸到薩卡拉。
en: Along the edge of the desert to the south,
the pyramids continue to Saqqara.

zh: 左塞爾金字塔在薩卡拉，
離吉薩約十五公里。
en: The Pyramid of Djoser stands at Saqqara,
about fifteen kilometres from Giza.

zh: 東邊的河谷裡，
是古都孟菲斯。
en: In the valley to the east
lay the ancient capital, Memphis.

zh: 金字塔都蓋在河谷西側的沙漠邊上，
都城則在河谷裡。
en: The pyramids were built on the desert edge west of the valley;
the capital lay in the valley itself.

zh: 再往南是達舒爾，
有紅色金字塔與彎曲金字塔。
en: Farther south is Dahshur,
with the Red Pyramid and the Bent Pyramid.

zh: 世界遺產的範圍有一萬六千公頃，
從吉薩一直延伸到達舒爾。
en: The World Heritage property covers 16,000 hectares,
from Giza all the way to Dahshur.

zh: 綠色的河谷與黃色的沙漠，
界線就是金字塔所在的地方。
en: Green valley and yellow desert:
the pyramids stand right on the line between them.

tagline.zh-Hant: 古夫金字塔的尺寸、石材，與九百公里外運來的花崗岩
tagline.en: The Great Pyramid's measurements, its stone, and granite from 900 km away

zh: 這部影片用數字來看古夫金字塔。
en: This film looks at the Great Pyramid through its numbers.

zh: 底座是正方形，
每邊約二百三十點三公尺。
en: Its base is a square
about 230.3 metres on each side.

zh: 原高一百四十六點六公尺，
現在約一百三十八點五公尺。
en: It was 146.6 metres high;
today it is about 138.5 metres.

zh: 估計用了兩百三十萬塊大石，
總重約六百萬公噸。
en: It is estimated at 2.3 million large blocks,
weighing about 6 million tonnes in all.

zh: 工期大約二十六年。
en: Construction took about 26 years.

zh: 外殼最底層的石塊高一點四九公尺，
上層每塊約五百公斤。
en: The lowest casing course is 1.49 metres tall;
upper casing stones weigh around 500 kilograms.

zh: 國王墓室的花崗岩，
來自九百多公里外的亞斯文。
en: The granite of the King's Chamber
came from Aswan, more than 900 kilometres south.

zh: 最大的花崗岩塊重二十五到八十公噸，
架在墓室與減壓室的頂上。
en: The largest granite blocks weigh 25 to 80 tonnes
and roof the King's Chamber and the relieving chambers.

zh: 內部的大走廊高八點六公尺，
長四十六點六八公尺。
en: Inside, the Grand Gallery is 8.6 metres high
and 46.68 metres long.

zh: 卡夫拉金字塔的高度與體積，
都比古夫金字塔略小一些。
en: Khafre's pyramid is slightly smaller in height and volume
than its neighbour.

zh: 孟卡拉金字塔的規模就小得多。
en: Menkaure's pyramid is relatively modest in size.

zh: 人面獅身像寬十九公尺，
後來又用石灰岩塊補砌修復。
en: The Sphinx is 19 metres wide;
it was later restored with layers of limestone blocks.

zh: 整個高原在開羅西南約十三公里，
尼羅河以西約九公里。
en: The whole plateau lies about 13 kilometres south-west of central Cairo
and 9 kilometres west of the Nile.

zh: 兩百三十萬塊石頭疊成的形狀，
從空中看，仍然是一個完美的正方形。
en: From the air, a shape stacked from 2.3 million stones
still reads as a square.
